evaluator_boundary: Structural outcomes are schema-test expectations; chronology, exact-reference, rights and independence outcomes require the independent semantic evaluator.

positive_controls.intent: Known target T and decision frontier K; exact source version and captured digest; source availability, ingestion and materialization before K; context inclusion bound to exact run manifest; rights permitted at decision and replay; two distinct synthetic assessor records with matching labels. The independent assessor labels also include evidence_validity_at_target_time=valid, and the final temporal adjudication records agreement separately from the engineering disposition.

structural_negative_controls.mutation: Set a validity bound state=unknown while retaining an instant.
Set source_version.bytes_state=captured without artifact_digest or byte_capture_evidence_ref.
Claim system_availability=available while acquisition_ingestion is not observed.
Claim run_context_presence=included while run_context_inclusion is not included and bound to a run manifest.
Claim rights_at_decision=permitted while the rights assessment is prohibited or unknown.
Include temporal_admissibility but omit temporal_admissibility_label from either assessor record.
Claim source_availability=admissible while both source_publication and issuer_availability are unknown/not established.
Select multi_source_causal_partial_order while causal_frontier.required=false or state=not_required.
Mark a required causal frontier complete while omitting an evidence-frontier digest, causal-history digest, source-set digest, verifier digest or verification receipt reference.
Set evidence_validity_at_target_time=valid/invalid while either validity bound is Unknown or interval_evidence_ref is absent.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: Move source_publication/issuer_availability after K while leaving outcome=admissible.
Move acquisition_ingestion or required derived_materialization after K while leaving system_availability=available.
Use a run manifest that does not contain the exact evidence_ref, version_ref and artifact_digest.
Record correction or supersession relation materialization after K but use it to rewrite the K projection.
Rights grant begins after K but outcome asserts permitted_at_decision.
Rights are revoked before replay/query but outcome asserts permitted_at_replay.
Clock uncertainty spans K but outcome asserts a definite before/after relation without qualified bound proof.
Two assessor records use the same person under different assessor_ref strings.
Assessor temporal labels disagree while temporal_adjudication.state=consensus.
Modify the temporal object after sealing without a superseding adjudication and new seal.
Compare local monotonic sequence numbers from different conductors or sort their wall-clock timestamps to claim a cross-conductor happens-before relation.
Use a scalar global maximum, sum or height as a complete causal frontier while a required source/conductor event or join is missing.
The causal-history receipt source set does not match the exact EvidenceFrontierV1 source-set digest.
Causal frontier is required but incomplete/unknown while system_availability=available or run_context_presence=included.
A causal edge has no evidence reference, a cycle exists, or a projection is not causally after its independently validated receipt.

Treat an EPCIS recordTime (repository bookkeeping/record-retrieval time) as the time the real-world event occurred, or use eventTime alone as proof that the event was available to the decision process by K.
semantic_negative_controls.note: Keep event occurrence assertion, repository receipt, publisher availability and decision-process acquisition as distinct temporal facts.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: A query requires evidence from pre-change, change-window and post-change periods, but the retrieved set contains only one period; the candidate nevertheless declares temporal coverage complete.
semantic_negative_controls.note: Report Temporal Coverage@k and Temporal Precision@k; relevance in one period does not compensate for missing required periods.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: The declared source inventory or source-set digest omits a required source/conductor, while the candidate claims complete evidence coverage or a complete decision frontier.
semantic_negative_controls.note: A frontier is complete only relative to a frozen and independently qualified source inventory; a cutoff is not corpus completeness.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: Two event-time uncertainty intervals overlap or have incompatible clock bounds, but the candidate invents a strict BEFORE/AFTER or cross-source happens-before edge.
semantic_negative_controls.note: Preserve concurrency/incomparability unless a verified causal edge or disjoint qualified intervals justify order.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: The candidate labels a dependency as causally influential solely from temporal succession, correlation or a co-occurrence pattern, without a justified causal mechanism, intervention or independently admissible causal edge.
semantic_negative_controls.note: Observed order, causal partial order and causal effect are different claims; score them separately.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: A bitemporal replay at K imports a later correction, supersession, retraction or source-version remapping that was not published, received and materialized by K.
semantic_negative_controls.note: Later knowledge may correct the present view but must not silently rewrite the historical decision-time projection.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: The candidate reports full Temporal Coverage@k using only retrieved/easy bins as the denominator, omitting required bins or hard negatives from the frozen query specification.
semantic_negative_controls.note: The denominator is the evaluator-frozen required temporal-bin universe, not the candidate's retrieved set.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: An action was authorized when planned, but the principal's role, permission, profile or target scope was revoked/changed before execution; the system executes without a fresh authorization check.
semantic_negative_controls.note: Decision-time evidence admissibility does not grant action-time authority. Recheck scope and authorization at the effect boundary.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: A client carries a cached MCP tool inventory from profile A and invokes it against profile B or a substituted endpoint without binding the exact tenant/profile/endpoint/tool-set identity and rechecking permissions.
semantic_negative_controls.note: Aras InnovatorEdge 2.4 documents multiple profiles with independent endpoints, Access Points, tool sets and enablement; this is a conformance/security test scenario, not a claim of vendor vulnerability.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: Promote a structurally valid, acyclic multi-conductor causal-history DAG to an authenticated causal-proof or real-world truth claim without independently resolving each edge evidence reference to the exact source/action bytes, accepted validator record, receiving-conductor identity, DNA/cell lineage and verifier identity.
semantic_negative_controls.note: A structural partial-order audit establishes internal consistency under its declared graph semantics; it does not authenticate the evidence references or prove the asserted physical event.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: A DSSE/in-toto role signature verifies relative to a caller-supplied trust-policy byte digest, but the policy is not authenticated by a pinned root; the evaluator labels the result root-authenticated, globally trusted, currently authorized or physically true.
semantic_negative_controls.note: ROLE_AUTHENTICATED_RELATIVE_TO_SUPPLIED_POLICY is not ROOT_AUTHENTICATED_POLICY_SNAPSHOT, SCITT transparency, current permission or event truth.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: A SCITT/COSE envelope is parsed and its opaque-byte SHA-256 commitment matches, but COSE signature, transparency-service identity and VDS receipt proof are not verified; the record is nevertheless reported as authenticated SCITT inclusion.
semantic_negative_controls.note: Envelope parsing and byte commitment do not verify the signature, issuer, transparency service or verifiable-data-structure proof.

semantic_negative_controls.mutation: Use a key that is revoked under the current trust policy to authorize a new current decision, or accept a historical signature without trusted-time evidence and the exact historical policy snapshot/epoch.
semantic_negative_controls.note: Current authorization and historical authentication are separate outcomes; missing historical trusted time or policy evidence cannot default to historical success.

metrics.definition: Required evaluator-frozen temporal bins with at least one admissible, claim-relevant evidence item divided by all bins frozen by the evaluator.
Retrieved items admissible for the requested decision frontier and target-time semantics divided by all retrieved items.
Decision claims supported by evidence whose required availability, ingestion or materialization exceeds K divided by all evidence-supported decision claims; critical target is zero.
Asserted cross-source causal-order edges lacking a valid independent causal-frontier receipt divided by all asserted cross-source causal-order edges.
Required source roles covered by the frozen evidence frontier divided by all evaluator-declared required source roles.
Exact agreement between the frozen K projection and independently reconstructed evidence, disposition and obligation outputs.
Count of critical claim-evidence pairs incorrectly represented as current/applicable; non-compensatory.
Fully burdened human, model, tool, review and rework cost per independently accepted decision; report absolute and matched-baseline ratios.

evaluation_extensions.scoring_rule: Hard safety, provenance and authority gates are reported before quality and economics. No weighted aggregate may compensate for a critical false-current, future-leakage, false-causal-edge or unauthorized-effect failure.
evaluation_extensions.status_note: Targets and baselines are preregistration only. No vendor tenant, candidate run, human gold labels or physical evidence is claimed.
